axes: glTF: +x bow, +y up, +z starboard, origin midships on the waterline (sea level y = 0); metres

materials.hb_opaque: COLOR_0.rgb = albedo, COLOR_0.a = pattern id / 16 (style C table). Optional float attribute _BRAND (per corner): 1 = replace rgb with the instance brand colour (boot-top stripe, pennants, ship's-boat bottom). COLOR_0 holds a fallback red there.
materials.hb_sail: Double-sided. COLOR_0.rgb = cloth colour. TEXCOORD_0 = sail space (u luff->leech, v foot->head; seams/tabling). TEXCOORD_1 = emblem space: the emblem square is exactly [0,1]^2 (outside = plain cloth). It reads correctly on the FRONT face (fore-and-aft sails: starboard face; square sails: forward face); flip u on back faces For mirrored nodes (port tack, det < 0) the rule generalises to: if (gl_FrontFacing == isMirrored) uv1.x = 1.0 - uv1.x. Only sail_main has emblem UVs inside [0,1].
materials.hb_cover: COLOR_0.rgb = shade (near white, darker underneath); final colour = instance brand colour * COLOR_0.rgb.

morphs.furl: Every mesh with a morph target named "furl": weight 0 = sail set / spar aloft / cover collapsed inside the boom, 1 = sail furled (flaked on the boom, rolled on the yard or the stay) / gaff+yard lowered / brand cover on. Drive all of them from one per-boat value. Default weight 0.

pose.set_shape: Set sails are modelled for wind from STARBOARD: camber to port (-z), jib clew slightly to port.
pose.starboard_tack: wind from starboard: boom and boom_2 rotation.y = -swing (boom out to port), sail_jib rotates -0.6*swing about its stay_axis, _heel.rotation.x = -heel (heel to port).
pose.port_tack: wind from port: scale.z = -1 on every node listed in mirror_nodes (mirrors camber and yard bracing about the centreline), boom and boom_2 rotation.y = +swing, jib +0.6*swing about its stay_axis, _heel.rotation.x = +heel. LOD: scale.z = -1 on the whole lod root.
mirror_nodes: sail_main (only when its parent is _heel, i.e. the ship)
pose.ranges: swing 0.25..0.9 rad (close-hauled..running), heel 0.08..0.2 rad. Docked: furl 1, swing 0, heel 0. Square sails (sail_main on the ship, sail_extra) do not swing: yards are braced 30 deg in the model.
pose.groups: boom (boom_spar, gaff, sail_main|sail_spanker, sail_cover) and boom_2 (boom_2_spar, gaff_2, sail_2, sail_cover_2) are empty pivots at the gooseneck; rotate/mirror the pivot, never the children.

anchors: bow_cleat / stern_cleat: mooring-line ends; masthead_light: riding light; wake_origin: stern on the waterline (not heeled); mooring_buoy.ring: buoy line end; dinghy.bow_cleat: painter.
lod: <id>_lod.glb: single mesh "lod" (hb_opaque, _BRAND boot + cover strip, morph furl collapses the sails), <= 150 tris.

props.pose: beached on her side, bow up

wreck_kit.status: new kit, not yet wired: the runtime still places wreck_a/b/c from "props"
wreck_kit.axes: glTF: +x bow, +y up, +z FRONT (seaward / camera side; the epitaph board faces +z). Origin = the ground under the wreck: y = 0 is the sand surface ("sits": sand) or the sea surface ("sits": water). Pose is BAKED (heel, pitch, burial, broken back): place at ground height, yaw only, do not heel again. Geometry below y = -0.7 is culled (keel buried); allow up to ~0.5 m of terrain unevenness.

materials.hb_opaque: COLOR_0.rgb = albedo with the weathering baked PER CORNER (sun bleach, salt tide mark, weed/kelp line, damp contact), COLOR_0.a = pattern id / 16 (style C table). No _BRAND / _PAINT: wrecks are never liveried.
materials.hb_emissive: lantern glass: emissive x uLamp (same contract as the civic kit)
materials.hb_window: hut / station panes: COLOR_0.r = lit, .g = warmth (civic contract)

epitaph.text: coin name (u left->right, v bottom->top); keep a 6% margin; dark ink on the weathered cream board (COLOR_0 ~ #CDC4AE)
epitaph.note: every wreck carries one, beside it on its front side; hide it to use the standalone wreck_cove_epitaph posts in the memorial row instead (recommended scale 2-2.5x at harbour zoom)

wreck_kit.two_sided: hb_opaque parts that are seen from both sides (holed hulls, rags, pennants) carry duplicated reversed faces: keep backface culling ON.
